title: Glowing volcano
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Sky glow behind volcano -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="45" rx="38" ry="28" fill="#3a1a2e" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- Smoke clouds -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="18" r="8" fill="#5a4a6a" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="14" r="10" fill="#6a5a7a" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="20" r="7" fill="#5a4a7a" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="35" cy="24" r="6" fill="#4a3a5a" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Volcano body - brown purple -->
  <path d="M15 92 Q30 50 42 38 L50 32 L58 38 Q70 50 85 92 Z" fill="#6b3a5a"/>
  <!-- Volcano lighter left side -->
  <path d="M15 92 Q30 50 42 38 L50 32 L50 92 Z" fill="#7a4a6a"/>
  <!-- Crater rim -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="34" rx="9" ry="4" fill="#8a5a7a"/>
  <!-- Dark crater inside -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="34" rx="6" ry="2.5" fill="#3a1a2e"/>
  <!-- Lava flow down the side -->
  <path d="M48 36 Q46 50 42 60 Q38 70 34 80 Q32 86 30 92 L36 92 Q38 84 42 74 Q46 62 48 50 Z" fill="#ff6a00"/>
  <path d="M52 36 Q54 48 56 58 Q58 68 62 80 Q64 86 66 92 L60 92 Q58 84 55 74 Q52 62 51 50 Z" fill="#ffaa00"/>
  <!-- Lava glow at top -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="35" rx="5" ry="2" fill="#ffdd00"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="35" rx="3" ry="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Lava pool glowing -->
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="37" rx="4" ry="1.5" fill="#ff8800"/>
  <!-- Bright lava spots -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="55" rx="2" ry="3" fill="#ffcc00"/>
  <ellipse cx="55" cy="62" rx="1.5" ry="2.5" fill="#ffcc00"/>
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="75" rx="1.5" ry="2" fill="#ffaa00"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="78" rx="1.5" ry="2" fill="#ffaa00"/>
  <!-- Rock chunks -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="88" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#5a3a4a"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="86" rx="4.5" ry="2.5" fill="#5a3a4a"/>
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="92" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#4a2a3a"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="93" rx="3.5" ry="2" fill="#4a2a3a"/>
  <!-- Small glow at summit -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="33" r="1.5" fill="#ffee66"/>
</svg>
